ownership_rule: The project owns this database; no application owns it or its table. The IN and OUT of a clip reach it only through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc.module.db-broker), whose table module qnc.module.clip-marks owns it.

rules.per_clip: One row per clip: its IN and OUT as last saved on the source timeline. A clip's first Save keeps where they were before it.
rules.history: The table is journaled: every write is a commit of the project's journal (who, when, before and after). The history of a clip is read from the journal; no second history is kept.
rules.back: Going back to a position is a write of the row and itself a commit; nothing is deleted by it.
